_: J group — PapyrusUtil StorageUtil per-Form KV (storageWrites) in-game demo, mirroring the easy CastMagic trigger of npc_skill_persist_spec.json. CAST ANY SPELL: a CastMagic Story-Manager quest (MFSW_Q) starts whenever the PLAYER casts a spell, and its OnStory<Event> handler writes three StorageUtil values keyed on the player — an int delta counter, a float delta accumulator, and a string stamp — exercising all three StorageWritesBody code paths (SetInt/AdjustInt, SetFloat/AdjustFloat, SetString). An SM-started quest never runs its startUpStage fragment (in-game 2026-06-19), so storageWrites routes to the OnStory handler automatically. ⚠ REQUIRES PapyrusUtil installed at runtime; compiling the generated MFSW_Q_Stages.psc needs PapyrusUtil's StorageUtil.psc on the Papyrus header path (main machine — already provisioned into ~/.cache/modforge/papyrus/Source/Scripts). StorageUtil values live in the SKSE co-save (auto save-managed, no JContainers). VERIFY in-game via console: cast a spell a few times, then `cgf "StorageUtil.GetIntValue" 14 "MFSW_castCount" -1` should return the cast count (14 = player), `cgf "StorageUtil.GetFloatValue" 14 "MFSW_castMagicka" -1` the float accumulator, `cgf "StorageUtil.GetStringValue" 14 "MFSW_lastCast" "none"` the stamp; save+reload and the int persists.

quests.name: StorageWrites Demo
quests._: CastMagic Story-Manager quest. The engine's Cast Magic story event starts it whenever the player casts a spell (GetIsID Player restricts the trigger to the player). type=None keeps it out of the journal. No aliases: every write is keyed on the player (Game.GetPlayer()) or none(global), so nothing needs an event-filled alias.

stages._: Three storageWrites keyed on the player, exercising every StorageWritesBody path. delta int → StorageUtil.AdjustIntValue (atomic +1 each cast); delta float → AdjustFloatValue (+0.5 each cast); str → SetStringValue (overwrite stamp). The stage carries the spec; the OnStory<Event> handler runs it (an SM quest's startUpStage fragment never fires). target=player is a pure Game.GetPlayer() expression → body-only, zero VMAD property.

storyEvent._: Fires when the player casts any spell. The condition restricts it to the player (GetIsID == Player, Skyrim.esm:0x00000014); the Cast Magic event's subject is the casting actor.
